title: Git Namespaces — List Bridge Jobs — payload
description: A namespace's administrators list the bridge jobs queued or run for it — every namespace, for a community administrator — with each job's kind, state and last error. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

namespace.description: Only jobs in this namespace. Absent: every administered namespace.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token from a previous response's `nextCursor`. A consumer supplying a `cursor` MUST NOT also change `namespace` or `state` from the request that produced it — start a fresh query instead.

limit.description: Maximum jobs to return in this page. A VTC clamps to 1..=500 (default 100).

JobId.title: JobId
JobId.description: The VTC's identifier for the job, unique across the VTC's jobs. The same identifier git-ns/bridge/job/0.4 assigns and git-ns/bridge/result/0.1 reports against.

JobKind.title: JobKind
JobKind.description: What the job asks the bridge to do — the same seven kinds git-ns/bridge/job/0.4 defines. Kept as its own enum here, rather than a cross-file $ref, because job/0.4 declares its `kind` inline rather than as a named $def; the two lists change together.

JobState.title: JobState
JobState.description: The VTC's own queue state for the job, driven by git-ns/bridge/result/0.1 reports. `pending` — queued, not yet accepted. `accepted` — the bridge has taken it and not yet reported an outcome. `succeeded` — every step completed. `partial` — some steps completed and at least one did not. `failed` — no step completed. `cancelled` — withdrawn before the bridge accepted it.

JobRow.title: JobRow
JobRow.description: One bridge job as the administrator's console shows it.

bridgeDid.description: The bridge the job was dispatched to.

repo.description: The repository the job acts on. Absent for a namespace-wide `inspect` sweep or a job with no repository (`beginBind`, `beginAccountLink`).

attempts.description: How many times the VTC has dispatched this job to a bridge.

createdAt.description: When the VTC queued the job.

acceptedAt.description: When a bridge last accepted it. Absent while `state` is `pending` or `cancelled`.

lastError.description: The bridge's last reported error, verbatim. Diagnostic prose for an administrator; a consumer MUST NOT parse it. Absent unless `state` is `partial` or `failed`.

Response.title: Git Namespaces — List Bridge Jobs — response payload

nextCursor.description: Continuation token for the next page, or `null` when this is the last.
